hook.name: Politiswap
hook.description: A hook that creates Uniswap v4 pools for political-themed ERC-20 tokens (PolTokens), enforcing that only the token contract (currency1) can initiate swaps. It extracts a fixed 2% fee on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, tracks daily net ETH flows per pool, and allows users to claim governance token rewards for trading in the highest-inflow pool each day.
